ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Required: create a long random admin password. Keep it private; this protects the admin API.

RELAY_URL.description: Optional: WebSocket URL of your independent VPS relay, e.g. wss://relay.example.com/ws. Leave empty to use Cloudflare only.

RELAY_SHARED_SECRET.description: Optional secret shared by the Worker and VPS relay. Use the same random 32+ character value in both places. Never publish it.
